name: phosphor-terminal-theme
description: A monochrome green CRT-terminal colour theme. Every colour is a shade of green; syntax is told apart by brightness, italic and bold.

scripts.package: npm run build && npm run check && node scripts/marketplace-readme.mjs && npx --yes @vscode/vsce package --readme-path build/README.marketplace.md
scripts.assets:png: rsvg-convert -w 1200 assets/banner.svg -o assets/banner.png && rsvg-convert -w 1200 assets/palette.svg -o assets/palette.png && rsvg-convert -w 256 -h 256 assets/icon.svg -o icon.png
